requirements.requirement: The system must validate that normalization converts all supported rating scales (e.g., 1-5, 1-10) into a consistent target scale with deterministic outputs.
The system must verify that weighting logic correctly prioritizes more recent ratings over older ratings according to defined rules.
The system must verify that weighting logic increases confidence as the number of ratings increases.
The system must produce a consistent composite reputation score for identical input datasets across multiple test runs.
The system must validate end-to-end integration from ratings ingestion through normalization and aggregation to API response output.
The system must ensure the API response includes reputation score, source count, and last updated timestamp fields.
The system must handle sparse data by returning a valid fallback score or null value without runtime failure.
The system must handle conflicting rating sources by applying normalization and aggregation rules without producing invalid scores.
The system must return a deterministic response structure even when no ratings data is available.
The system must ensure unit tests cover all normalization branches including minimum, maximum, and midpoint values.
The system must ensure integration tests simulate multiple external sources with differing scales and timestamps.
The system must ensure that invalid rating inputs (e.g., negative values, values exceeding scale) are rejected or sanitized without crashing.
The system must ensure test coverage includes edge cases where only a single rating exists.
The system must ensure test coverage includes edge cases where multiple sources provide identical ratings.
The system must ensure LLM-generated explanations of ratings (if invoked) reflect the computed score without numerical inconsistency.
The system must ensure LLM outputs do not fabricate rating sources not present in the input dataset.
The system must ensure LLM explanations include mention of source count when such metadata is available.
The system must ensure LLM explanations degrade gracefully when ratings data is sparse or missing.
The system must ensure LLM explanations do not contradict normalized scores or weighting logic.
The system must ensure LLM outputs remain consistent across repeated runs given identical inputs and prompts.
